tasks_completed.description: Replaced the leak-prone inline regex walk with a bounded scanner for the selected inline Markdown slice.
tasks_completed.changes: Closed delimiters are now required for ***, **, *, ~~, code, links, kbd, and LaTeX tokens; escaped token starts are ignored; \* and escaped markdown-link literals remain plain.
tasks_completed.rationale: The BA root cause identified end-of-string delimiter acceptance as the reason complaint-shaped emphasis could consume later strikethrough/link/code tokens. The scanner fixes the token boundary instead of weakening downstream rendering checks.

tasks_completed.description: Rendered table header/cell strings through the existing span renderer at render time.
tasks_completed.changes: Web and native table paths now call parseMarkdownSpans(...) and RenderSpans(...) for headers/cells while preserving row[colIndex] ?? '' empty-cell fallback and existing horizontal scroll containers.
tasks_completed.rationale: The BA root cause identified table strings bypassing RenderSpans after 0dd09cc3 restored string rows for empty-cell preservation. Render-time parsing restores inline formatting without changing the protected table data shape.

tasks_completed.description: Added regression coverage for AC1 through AC4 parser/data-shape requirements.
tasks_completed.changes: Added fixtures for bounded ***, strikethrough/link/code after emphasis, selected escapes, LaTeX, kbd, autolinks, code precedence, table empty cells, and header/list/task-list/numbered-list parser call sites.
tasks_completed.rationale: The parser is shared by text, header, unordered-list, task-list, and numbered-list blocks; tests prove the selected fix did not regress those call sites.

tasks_completed.changes: Section 2 now records approach/rationale; Section 3 records exact file/line edits; stale tool-card checkpoints cp-02/cp-03 were waived as out of scope for the BA-narrowed markdown slice.
tasks_completed.rationale: The spec-driven workflow requires lifecycle notes and checkpoint closure while preserving the current task's no-broadened-scope boundary.

blast_radius.impact_note: High impact: MarkdownView has more than five importers; QA should exercise normal messages, sidebar/task/tool markdown views, changelog, artifact, and session message routes as practical.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: 0dd09cc3 for table-cell inline regression; no single confirmed commit for *** leakage
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: 0dd09cc3 preserved empty table cells by restoring string table rows, which also bypassed inline span rendering. The older regex span parser accepted end-of-string as a delimiter close and let overlapping asterisk runs corrupt later tokens.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: The table parser shape stays string[]/string[][] and cells are parsed only at render time; the inline parser now requires real unescaped closing delimiters and treats selected escaped punctuation as literal text.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: BA explicitly required exact parser-first coverage for AC1/AC3/AC4 and a deterministic replacement for the delimiter-leaking regex branch; the added lines are concentrated in that scanner plus required regression tests.
